title: cyclosorus doodioides
intro: Cyclosorus doodioides, commonly known as the "Wild Oak Fern", is a species of fern native to tropical regions of Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cyclosorus doodioides include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and bronchodilator, making it useful in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
